name: The Howling Silence
source:
Sam and Kate, two college friends, are on their way to a fun, snowy vacation when they decide to follow their GPS onto an abandoned mountain road. 

After getting into an accident, Kate goes to look for help while Sam stays behind. But when Kate doesn’t return, Sam must search for her in the isolated forest – where something lurks in the trees, watching her.

[From [url=https://kiki-cakes.itch.io/the-howling-silence]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
山姆和凯特是两个大学好友，他们正在去享受一个有趣的雪地假期的路上，他们决定沿着GPS进入一条废弃的山路。

发生事故后，凯特前去寻求帮助，而山姆则留下来。但当凯特没有回来时，山姆必须在偏僻的森林里寻找她——那里有东西潜伏在树上，监视着她。

[来自[url=https://kiki-cakes.itch.io/the-howling-silence]Itch.io[/url]]
